# Research question

Status: open. Checked: YYYY-MM-DD.

## Question and context

What decision does this research support? Which hosts or services are affected?

## Findings and sources

For each finding, link the owning documentation or source and record the version or date. Separate documented behavior from your recommendation.

## Options and recommendation

Record alternatives, reasons, costs, and unresolved questions. Link related concepts and decisions.

## Follow-up

Record what requires a local experiment or live verification. Add a guide only when the steps are concrete enough to follow.
